0022600134.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-1) are on a two-game winning streak, sitting 1st in the Southeast and 3rd in the East with a 1-0 road record, while the Detroit Pistons (3-1) are 1st in the Central and 1st in the East after a loss in their most recent game. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery), and Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), with Ausar Thompson listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in the 2026-27 season, and in the 2025-26 season series the Hornets lost 0-3, including a 118-100 loss in Charlotte on April 10, 2026.
